systems.name: Legacy NAV SP1 Groth16 aggregate
systems.status: historical profile compatibility only; real-value provenance incomplete
systems.proof_binding: Groth16Verifier verifies the entire public-values byte string against the profile-bound 32-byte SP1 program vkey and the pinned sp1-verifier Groth16 VK
systems.packet_binding: decoded spot_total + cash_total - liability must equal reserve_packet.verified_net_assets
systems.residual_gate: The aggregate guest source, build recipe and program-vkey reproduction are not present in this repository. The host decodes only the fields above and accepts a minimum ABI length; production activation requires exact guest provenance, a canonical ABI/vector package and governed program/VK activation evidence.
systems.bounded_bridge_verify: verify_bounded_sp1_groth16 (nav_sp1_verifier.rs) cryptographically verifies a size-bounded SP1 Groth16 proof against the profile-bound program vkey and pinned Groth16 VK without decoding the NAV aggregate ABI; dedicated bridge programs (e.g. pfUSDC Tier-4 ingress/egress) decode and bind their own public values after this check. Fail-closed on verifier-kind mismatch, empty proof/public-values, or oversize inputs.

private_witnesses: canonical CBOR reserve witness bounded to 8 MiB
manifest entries for up to 64 ordered provider-neutral sources
signatures or state proofs selected by each manifest-pinned adapter
systems.proof_binding: The public SP1 guest validates the manifest, source evidence, trust classification, liabilities and context, then commits exactly 584 bytes. Groth16Verifier verifies those bytes against the profile-bound program vkey and the pinned SP1 Groth16 VK.
host_only_checks: chain genesis, NAV asset, proof profile, manifest, valuation policy and valuation unit equality
packet epoch, observation interval, maximum snapshot age and maximum observation span
packet proof-backed value, source root or subscription-overlay composite root, and valuation trust root
floating-NAV reserve floor and consensus state-transition invariants
systems.reproduction_evidence: The repository contains the guest, shared types, adapters, CLI, fixture vectors, build metadata and pinned ELF. A clean public checkout reproduced execution and a CPU Groth16 proof with this program vkey on 2026-08-01.

verdict.source_publication: AssetOrchard live public-instance and witness bindings and the provider-neutral NAV reserve proof ABI are fully inventoried. The successor NAV guest, build recipe, adapters and deterministic vectors are public and locally reproducible. The legacy NAV aggregate and debug adapter remain explicitly contained compatibility surfaces.
verdict.real_value: The provider-neutral framework is locally qualified, but the six A666 source adapters are 0/6 production-qualified. Live real-value activation remains gated on public collectors, adversarial and fuzz qualification, fresh A666 epochs and complete reconciliation, a reproducible successor guest/program identity, governed profile/program registration, validator rollout and rollback evidence, an independent operator reproduction, and exact live candidate-run evidence.
